propositions: Regex matching and scope extraction code in gates.py, det_floor.py, and assemble.py currently keys on '## Success Criteria' heading but must be repointed to '## Acceptance Criteria' to unify the criteria vocabulary and enable store migration verification.
Test fixtures across seven test files embed '## Success Criteria' in ticket descriptions and must be migrated to use '## Acceptance Criteria' with checkbox items to satisfy the P1 blocking floor.

The clarity score for epics must remain at 6 when repointing the +2 bonus from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria (verified by actual scoring: 440 chars with SC yields 6, repoint yields 6 unchanged), avoiding fixture fragility and regression across 108 migrated tickets.
The two _clarity_score implementations in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep in their epic branches, as required by module comments.
A new contract test must prove an epic with '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Context' passes both clarity-check and check-ac gates, and that _clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') equals 6.

All code references to 'Success Criteria' must be removed from source files, and '## success criteria' must be dropped from _SCOPE_HEADINGS while all fixture corpus references are migrated or moved to negative-case probes in the new test file.
